local_learn.observation: Revision 20 changes the decision boundary from always demanding a new positive-control run to first checking whether an adequately proven equivalent original control already exists. A bounded provenance-equivalence audit is therefore the smallest decision-changing unit before any scientist-derived negative interpretation.

result.claim_boundary: This unit adjudicates reuse eligibility for one named AI Scientist-v2 baseline artifact against one frozen O comparison contract. A failed equivalence audit means only that reuse is not proven under those exact fields; it is not negative evidence about AI Scientist-v2, any scientist-agent family, or any untested mechanism.

result.goal: Adjudicate whether the already recorded AI Scientist-v2 baseline evidence is provenance-equivalent to the frozen scientist positive-control contract. Reuse it without reproduction only if every frozen configuration and condition is actually supported; otherwise report the exact equivalence gaps and retain INSUFFICIENT_POSITIVE_CONTROL without drawing any negative inference about the original method, scientist-agent family, or untested mechanisms.

success_conditions: the audit uses only frozen, digest-bound sources and does not alter the precommitted comparison protocol
reuse is admitted only when every required equivalence condition has adequate provenance and the validator accepts the exact object
lack of equivalence is classified only as insufficient evidence for reuse, not failure of the baseline or scientist-agent family
no duplicate positive-control run is required when equivalence is proven, and no duplicate run is scheduled merely to close this audit
